description: Auto-format files after editing (Black for Python, Prettier for JS/JSX/TS)

hooks.command: FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE" == *.py ]]; then python -m black "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; elif [[ "$FILE" == *.jsx || "$FILE" == *.js || "$FILE" == *.ts || "$FILE" == *.tsx ]]; then npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
